sql_query: SELECT e.last_name, e.first_name, SUM(od.total_order_value) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS total_order_value FROM order_details GROUP BY order_id) od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
